Fusionner état conversation
Valider paramètres création
Lire tentative de session
claimSqlSamples.snippet:
SELECT
  id::text AS attempt_id,
  status AS attempt_status,
  appointment_reference,
  lease_until,
  expires_at,
  resume_count
FROM public.ai_appointment_attempt
WHERE session_id = $1
  AND status IN ('AWAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'SUBMITTING', 'UNCERTAIN', 'CONFIRMED')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

claimSqlSamples.name: Décider action tentative
Réclamer tentative
claimSqlSamples.snippet:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),
entropy AS (
  SELECT 'own-' || encode(public.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex') AS lease_owner
)
SELECT f.acquired, f.attempt_id::text, f.attempt_status, f.request_payload, f.idempotency_key, f.request_fingerprint, f.resume_count, e.lease_owner
FROM input
CROSS JOIN entropy e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.reclamer_tentative_rendez_vous(
  (input.data->>'attemptId')::uuid,
  input.data->>'sessionId',
  e.lease_owner
) AS f;
